_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
9:48AM - Shooting Star, The Gondola and Snow Bowl Express are on wind delay. Stay tuned for updates.

12/30 5:50AM - Top of the morning, Stratton! It’s a bit chilly out there today with summit temperatures forecasted between 0-4 degrees and base temperatures between 9-13 degrees. Don't forget to grab an extra layer and keep that face covered. We are planning to have 12 lifts scheduled to spin at 8:30am; however, high winds with gusts up to 50mph are in the forecast and wind delays are expected. Early access will be available for First Tracks pass holders, conditions permitting.

For your way down, we plan on having 58 trails open, all of which were smoothed out overnight. Trails will be assessed by ski patrol all throughout the day and may impact this trail count. East Byrnes Side is back online with 6 features including the 13 foot ramp halfpipe which received a fresh cut this morning. Due to the cold temperatures, strong winds, and firm surface conditions, beginner skiing and riding from the summit is not recommended today.

Colder temperatures moving in and sticking around have allowed snowmaking and resurfacing operations to begin and will continue over the next several days as our team works to prepare the mountain for the New Year.

Stay safe, stay warm, and stay stoked as we approach the New Year. See you out there!

Safety Tip: Stay on the groomed portion of trails. 

Hungry? Luckily for you, Holiday week is in full swing with extended dining hours, live music, and special events keeping the Village looking lively. Check out our Holiday Week Dining, Après & Live Music Guide to see what's open, happening, and where the music is at.
